prediction_text: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election. The conference-panel reading follows the dominant signal in the card: Clinton, ahead in most polls through October, defeats Donald Trump in the election of 8 November 2016 and becomes president-elect, though the margin is narrower than the polling lead suggested.
basis:
Card carries no tradition field; the card is an election-forecast panel item, method chosen accordingly.
systems_used: western mundane astrology panel reading plus electoral-structure reading. Card facts at asking time (October 2016): most polls favour Clinton; no contrary configuration is supplied on the card. An independent reading from the supplied facts alone gives the front-runner the win; the narrowing clause is included because late-cycle challenger momentum is a standing feature of such races, but no card fact supports reversing the direction. R87 candidate coordinates: 8 November 2016 (election day, trigger = the vote) taken; no other date carries a trigger.
